title: Google Drive connection and scope readiness

scopeEnforcement.folderDescentPolicy: Selected folder does NOT authorize unpicked pre-existing or future children. Only app-created or explicitly picked files are accessible.

storageAndTransferModes.import_copy: Verified. Downloads file bytes into app storage, verifies checksum, scans for malware, durable offline cache upon client ack. Preserved on remote file deletion or disconnect.
storageAndTransferModes.link_reference: Verified. Stores provider file reference only. Does not consume app storage. Reflects permission_lost or source_unavailable if removed in Drive.
storageAndTransferModes.upload_to_drive: Verified. App file upload with idempotency tracking to prevent duplicates.
storageAndTransferModes.vault_exclusion: Verified. Encrypted vault files and secrets are strictly excluded from Drive connector.

cryptoAndFencing.tokenEncryption: AES-256-GCM sealed at rest with AAD bound to workspaceId, connectionId, accountId, and key version. Fails closed on key absence or tampering.
cryptoAndFencing.disconnect: Stored tokens wiped immediately, pending jobs cancelled, generation incremented, remote originals in Google Drive untouched, imported copies retained in app.
cryptoAndFencing.generationFencing: Late jobs or token refreshes with stale generation are strictly fenced (status=fenced) and cannot resurrect disconnected state.

liveGoogleOAuthReason: Owner Google Cloud project OAuth credentials (DAYNORI_DRIVE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID / SECRET) and live interactive consent are unconfigured. Fake provider strictly rejected in production runtimes under fail-closed gates.
